status: Independent postrun interpretation; no new fitting or corpus mutation
main_finding: The specified affine readout at the supplied common prefix does not show a template-family-held-out advantage over the seven-feature nuisance baseline:4/26 versus9/26 complete pairs. The paired advantage statistic is-5, with exploratory upper-tail fraction.89.

supporting_observations.z_same_full_diff_subset: 2/6, a secondary nested subset; not additional pairs and not enough to overturn the primary comparison
supporting_observations.nuisance_pair_concentration: 8 of9 completed pairs come from four guard quartets: allocation-null-guard, zero-worker-guard, write-permission-check, allocation-product-overflow. The ninth is validated-port-conversion. This makes the available count/length shortcuts a concrete data concern, without proving which cues the earlier generative model used.
supporting_observations.numerical_validity: All4004 fits met the preregistered gradient convergence rule. No observed score is exactlyzero; z minimum absolute score0.0008021921660301458, nuisance0.14721037758222139. There is no score-level evidence here for changing labels or requesting optional numerical refits.
supporting_observations.capacity: True and first-permuted z fits both classify all52 training rows correctly, but mean CE0.0012323346561498997 and0.0012610003663753578 exceed the frozen0.001 capacity criterion. Both capacity_success values remainfalse. Correct training labels alone demonstrate cohort fitting, not semantic transfer.

what_this_does_not_establish: No conclusion that Qwen lacks relevant information: only one state, affine head, normalization and lambda were tested.
No conclusion that Instruct caused earlier failure; Base-vs-Instruct remains an untested model comparison.
No conclusion that notorch is generally bug-free; this particular native extraction/solver path passed its prespecified gates.
No isolation of the previous LoRA bottleneck. This probe changes objective and readout, and its grouped predictions are not directly comparable to original training-generation scores.
No full-review competence, natural prefix generation, citation correctness or grounded explanation result.
No resolution of whether previous100-update LoRA training was sufficient.
Permutation fractions are exploratory conditional references under family label-exchangeability assumptions, not confirmatory significance.

recommended_next_step.priority: A separate data-only counterbalance intervention, rather than interpreting this as a reason to replace the model now.
recommended_next_step.design: Keep cohort size and broad task contract controlled; replace harmful neutral no-op contexts with ineffective protective lookalikes that match clean after-side if/sort/credit counts. Preserve both diff shapes and pair labels per family. Audit behavior of each ineffective/effective protection, not just syntax.
recommended_next_step.controls: Keep model, adapter placement, objective, update budget and scoring fixed for that experiment. Freeze new independent template families before training or scoring; current52 and previously seen transfercases are development data. Audit exact nuisance vector and lexical marker balance before optimization.
recommended_next_step.claim: This would test whether shortcut availability impedes learning or assessment. It would not by itself test broader adapter placement, longer duration or Instruct status; those need separate controlled comparisons.
recommended_next_step.not_done: No new corpus, head, optimization, adapter change or model swap was executed by this auditor.

later_separate_tests: A duration-only LoRA comparison with genuine optimizer-state resume or a deterministic fresh rerun whose initial trajectory is verified.

A broader adapter-placement comparison if data controls remain weak; repository research identifies that the present final-MLP-only scope is narrower than common whole-backbone recipes, not a proven cause.
A matched Base-vs-Instruct comparison after data/procedure controls, without silently changing template, token boundaries and evaluation.
